figures.finding: No film, television or stage agreement or minimum was found for Anguilla; the only pay floor in its law is the general minimum rate of wages, EC$16.20 (US$6.00) an hour from 1 January 2024, ordered by the Executive Council under the Labour (Relations) Act.
figures.applies: Anguilla (British Overseas Territory), all employees, from 1 January 2024; the UK's own film and stage agreements (Equity, Pact) do not extend to it by any source found.

figures.finding: English is Anguilla's language: by the May 2001 census, the first to ask about languages, 99% of residents (11,329 people) speak English well enough to hold a conversation; 101 do not, Spanish being the first language of 82 of them.
